annotations.title: Approve or deny a held sandbox payment

description: Approves or denies a payment that sandbox_pay reported as waiting for approval, as the human approver would with `spendctl approve`. Use it only with an approval id from this sandbox; in the real product a human decides, in the sandbox the model plays that role. Returns the approval id and its new status (approved or denied). An approved payment completes when sandbox_pay is called again with the same approvalId; a denied one stays refused. Deciding the same approval twice keeps the first decision.

approvalId.description: The approval id returned by sandbox_pay in its "waiting for approval" result (Approval id: ...)

decision.description: approve releases the held payment; deny refuses it for good

note.description: Optional reason recorded with the decision, up to 200 characters

sandbox_id.description: The sandbox_id returned by sandbox_create (32 hex characters)

name: approve
title: Approve or deny a held sandbox payment
